subject: Rupert Murdoch
reviewer: Codex (GPT-6), distinct same-agent review; no independent human or subagent review
method: Read the current questions and all rationales in a separate pass after drafting. Challenged literal wording, per-axis evidence, neutrality, counter-evidence and the distinction between Murdoch and his outlets. Reviewed before any diagnostic neighbour result was inspected.
findings: All exact questionnaire choices are inferred, including choices closely grounded in direct speeches; this conservative labelling avoids claiming he submitted these statements.

Lowy and ABC host different primary speeches but are not independent observers of those speeches. Grist interviewed him independently (with a declared HarperCollins book relationship); TheWrap independently reports his own gun/vaccination statements. Reuters testimony is separately credited rather than counted as an independent ABC investigation. AP independently contextualises his 2023 transition; TIME reproduces the refugee intervention.

Corrected Scottish source to the actually opened Guardian report after City A.M. full-text access timed out. Tweets express interest, not a settled universal secession policy; the central/local extrapolations remain low confidence.
Added later 2014 climate counter-evidence. The source is a critical commentary quoting an interview, not a scientific assessment by Murdoch; only his reported outlook is used.

Authority 03 is Neutral for a substantive distinction: banning automatic weapons does not rule out all licensed defensive ownership. Vaccination encouragement is not evidence of a mandate, so 07 remains an explicit modest inference.
Democracy 04, 08, 11 and 13 retain the exact lawful/temporary limits. Opposition to unaccountable government is not used to force opposition to all representative delegation.

Culture/Nature 14 rationale strengthened with his Boyer-6 rejection of racial superiority; that historical claim does not directly establish a crime-causation view. Neutral causal comparisons reflect mixed causal interpretations rather than assigning a political label to biology.
Public/private 16 distinguishes a public broadcaster alongside private competitors from exclusive state broadcasting. Delivering an ABC lecture is not proof of an ownership policy.
Redistribution accepts genuine-need support and possible progressive taxes; no unsupported flat-tax or welfare-abolition doctrine was substituted.

Secular/religious separates civil-law authority from conventional ceremonies, voluntary churches and religious identity. Refugee religious preference is counter-evidence to uniform neutrality, not evidence of mandatory clerical government.

Progressive/traditionalist uses biographical social-conservative evidence cautiously; family policy, adoption and identity-language responses remain uncertain. Republicanism and commercial sexual content supply counter-evidence to uniform traditionalism.
Innovation enthusiasm does not settle medical reliability or invasive enhancement. Modest precaution answers are independently assessed rather than mirroring all digital-commerce answers.

Neutral-heavy axes (if validation flags them) contain explicit substantive balancing rationales. Particularly uncertain: Culture/Nature, secular institutional details, central/local administration and medical enhancement. Structural validation cannot certify these interpretations.

Literal wording cross-check caught a mistaken description of public/private 01–07 in the first draft. Reassessed all seven against their exact current-bank ownership statements before archive; corrected both values and rationales. This was an interpretation correction, not score targeting.

Reviewed the five neutral-count warnings individually. Immigration balances family admission, lawful entry and security selection; social norms balance family preference with permissive commerce; innovation balances noninvasive progress with irreversible medical risk; regional powers balance autonomy with shared standards; causal traits use a mixed-causation interpretation. Neutral is retained for those stated substantive balances, not used merely because research was unsuccessful. These interpretations remain uncertain.
